sealed-classes-permitted-hierarchy.title: Sealed class hierarchies
sealed-classes-permitted-hierarchy.short: Restrict which classes may extend a type
sealed-classes-permitted-hierarchy.summary: Use sealed types to define a closed set of permitted direct subclasses.
sealed-classes-permitted-hierarchy.why: A closed hierarchy lets APIs express controlled alternatives and enables stronger exhaustiveness checks.
sealed-classes-permitted-hierarchy.tips: Every permitted direct subclass must be final, sealed, or non-sealed.

pattern-matching-switch-exhaustiveness.title: Exhaustive pattern switch
pattern-matching-switch-exhaustiveness.short: Match a closed type hierarchy with switch
pattern-matching-switch-exhaustiveness.summary: Pattern matching in switch can select behavior by runtime type.
pattern-matching-switch-exhaustiveness.why: Exhaustiveness checking helps keep switches aligned with sealed hierarchies.
pattern-matching-switch-exhaustiveness.tips: Prefer exhaustive cases over a broad default when all permitted variants should be handled explicitly.

list-copyof-immutable-snapshot.title: Immutable list snapshot with List.copyOf
list-copyof-immutable-snapshot.short: Copy a collection into an unmodifiable list
list-copyof-immutable-snapshot.summary: List.copyOf creates an unmodifiable list from an existing collection.
list-copyof-immutable-snapshot.why: It prevents later structural changes through the returned list and separates it from later source mutations.
list-copyof-immutable-snapshot.tips: Remember that the contained objects themselves are not deep-copied.

string-repeat-fixed-count.title: Repeat a string
string-repeat-fixed-count.short: Build repeated text without a manual loop
string-repeat-fixed-count.summary: String.repeat returns a string repeated a specified number of times.
string-repeat-fixed-count.why: It states the intent directly and avoids loop bookkeeping for simple repetition.
string-repeat-fixed-count.tips: The count must be non-negative; consider output size before repeating large strings.

optional-get-nosuchelement.title: Optional.get on an empty value
optional-get-nosuchelement.short: Empty Optional has no value to return
optional-get-nosuchelement.summary: Calling get on Optional.empty throws NoSuchElementException.
optional-get-nosuchelement.why: Optional represents possible absence, so callers must choose an absence policy.
optional-get-nosuchelement.tips: Prefer orElse, orElseGet, orElseThrow, or conditional access according to the API contract.

enum-valueof-illegalargument.title: Enum.valueOf name mismatch
enum-valueof-illegalargument.short: Enum lookup requires the exact constant name
enum-valueof-illegalargument.summary: Enum.valueOf throws IllegalArgumentException when no constant has the supplied name.
enum-valueof-illegalargument.why: The lookup is case-sensitive and uses declared constant names rather than display labels.
enum-valueof-illegalargument.tips: Validate external text or map it explicitly before calling valueOf.

sealed-class-missing-permits-modifier.title: Invalid permitted sealed subclass
sealed-class-missing-permits-modifier.short: A permitted subclass needs a hierarchy modifier
sealed-class-missing-permits-modifier.summary: A direct subclass of a sealed type must declare final, sealed, or non-sealed.
sealed-class-missing-permits-modifier.why: The modifier tells the compiler whether inheritance stops or continues below that subclass.
sealed-class-missing-permits-modifier.tips: Choose final when further extension is not intended.

switch-expression-missing-yield.title: Missing yield in a switch expression block
switch-expression-missing-yield.short: A block case must produce the switch value
switch-expression-missing-yield.summary: Use yield to return a value from a statement block inside a switch expression.
switch-expression-missing-yield.why: A bare expression statement does not supply the value required by the surrounding switch expression.
switch-expression-missing-yield.tips: Use arrow expression cases when no multi-statement block is needed.

generic-varargs-array-exposure-warning.title: Generic varargs array exposure
generic-varargs-array-exposure-warning.short: Do not expose the backing generic varargs array
generic-varargs-array-exposure-warning.summary: Returning a parameterized varargs array can leak an array whose runtime type cannot express the full generic type.
generic-varargs-array-exposure-warning.why: Type erasure and reified arrays make the exposed array vulnerable to heap pollution.
generic-varargs-array-exposure-warning.tips: Prefer collection-based APIs or make a safe defensive representation instead of exposing the array.

double-nan-equality-trap.title: Comparing a value with NaN
double-nan-equality-trap.short: NaN is not equal to itself
double-nan-equality-trap.summary: Use Double.isNaN instead of equality to test for NaN.
double-nan-equality-trap.why: IEEE 754 comparisons define NaN as unequal to every value, including NaN itself.
double-nan-equality-trap.tips: Use isNaN whenever NaN is a meaningful sentinel or calculation result.
